#ad ☁️ The easiest elevated hosting hack you’ll ever try. I’m all about intentional living and keeping things effortless—which means my hosting style needs to be quick to set up, but still feel incredibly chic. I used the Royale Infinite Answers tool to find a shortcut to an aesthetic setup using just one surprise household staple. The result? A sleek, minimalist, geometric table runner made entirely out of Royale Ultra Strength. 🤍 It protects the wood from cold drink condensation, makes cleanup a breeze, and completely elevates the space. Practical, but make it high-end. ✨ Save this hack for your next gathering, and go try a prompt for yourself on Infinite Answers! Don't forget to tag @theroyalekittens so we can see your aesthetic setups. 🕊️ #RoyaleInfiniteAnswer #RoyalePartner

OHIP REJECTED the life-saving care Sydney needs after surviving a car accident. Today, at 27, she is largely bed-bound and relies on a wheelchair. Her family says they’ve exhausted their options in Canada. She’s been accepted for surgery in New York, but OHIP DENIED THEIR FUNDING! So her dad pushed her wheelchair 200 KM from London to Queen’s Park to fight for his daughter. No family should have to go this far to access the care their child needs. Please share this story and if you can, join me and thousands of Canadians across the country donating to save her life! @miles4amiracle
